name_en: Abura zomen — somen fried with pork and a splash of broth until the oil turns silky
summary_ja: 豚肉とそうめんをだし汁ごと炒め、油と出汁を乳化させてまとわせる奄美地域の一皿。小麦を育てない奄美でそうめんが根づいた経緯は定かでないが、八月踊りなど人が集まる行事に欠かせない。
summary_en: Pork and somen are fried together with a splash of broth, the oil and stock emulsifying into a silky coat on the noodles. Just how somen took root in wheat-free Amami isn't clear, but the dish is a fixture whenever people gather, not least for the August Dance festival.
source_title: 油ゾーメン 鹿児島県｜うちの郷土料理
